text:
tara-support: Escalation from AcmeCorp — streaming chat sessions get a partial last event then connection drops on reconnect. Customer sees 401s on client reconnects and billing spikes from reconnect loops. Logs attached.

jess-customer: hitting this in prod since yesterday ~14:10 UTC. users see message stop, then clients auto-reconnect and get 401, then partial text shows in UI. sample req id: req_0a1b2c3d

tara-support: Thanks Jess. Ticket created INC-5432. Can you paste minimal repro request/headers? Also what fronting infra (Cloudflare/ALB/NLB/etc)?

jess-customer: fronted by Cloudflare (managed WAF) -> ALB -> app. tokens are short-lived (60s) and rotated by client on reconnect. here's curl we used to test:

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  "https://api.acme.example.com/v1/stream?session=abcd"
```

mike-eng: quick triage notes: we see `200` and chunks for ~22-28s then ALB appears to send FIN. Cloudflare sometimes buffers small middle-chunks and performs HTTP/1.1 -> HTTP/2 gateway changes that can reorder or truncate trailing bytes. When the client reconnects it posts the new token and ALB sometimes reuses a different backend connection causing a 401 from our auth middleware because token rotation race.

ana-infra: pinging infra: ALB idle timeout is 30s, Cloudflare origin timeout is 60s, but CF will probe and sometimes re-issue requests on our behalf. That mismatch + token rotation is suspicious.

mike-eng: Repro on our side with `ngrok` and a simulated Cloudflare worker: if token is replaced during reconnect window we see auth middleware reject with `401` and client lib retries immediately resulting in tight reconnect loop. Also saw SSE trailing chunk truncated like `data: {...` (no newline) — client SSE parser treats as incomplete and closes.

tara-support: Proposed mitigations for customer to try:
- increase ALB idle timeout to > 180s temporarily
- add single-character heartbeat every 15s (e.g., `: heartbeat` or `\n`) to keep proxies from coalescing
- on client, backoff reconnects and fetch fresh token before retry
- add `Connection: keep-alive` and set `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` explicitly from origin

eli-sales: customer worried about billing due to retry storms. Can we offer a credits gesture if we confirm server-side blame?

mike-eng: we need traces. @jess-customer can you provide a full tcpdump/pcap from a failing client session and one from an internal test run? Also capture headers (esp `Connection`, `Keep-Alive`, `Via`, `CF-Ray`) and the exact token timestamp.

jess-customer: uploading pcap now -> link: https://files.acme.example.com/pcap/6789012345.pcap

sre-bot: Incident INC-5432 created, priority: high. Assigning oncall.

ana-infra: I verified ALB logs — there is a sequence where ALB closes backend socket with `Idle timeout` at 30s while CF still holds client side open. That produces a half-close where last chunk arrives but FIN races and chunk boundary lost.

mike-eng: Root cause hypothesis: mismatch between Cloudflare origin timeout and ALB idle timeout + short-lived client tokens causing reconnects during proxy handoff. Secondary: CF WAF sometimes rewrites chunk boundaries when buffering small chunks, leading to incomplete final SSE event.

tara-support: Next steps:
1) Ask customer to increase ALB idle timeout to 300s and add heartbeat for 24h test window.
2) Customer to implement client-side token refresh before reconnect and exponential backoff.
3) We will run a controlled repro using CF worker + ALB with short tokens to validate.
4) If we confirm server-side contributions, discuss billing credit.

mike-eng: I'll run repro today and post logs + coredump if needed.

jess-customer: doing ALB change now, will report back in 30m. thanks everyone :heart:

tara-support: keeping ticket open. If this reproduces with ALB=300s, we can rule out idle timeout. If it persists, we'll capture deeper kernel-level traces.
